name: Cleanup After Wall Finish
intent: Pull trim masking, vacuum the floor, remove fixture protection, clean tools, and walk the room for a final inspection. Final inspection rate slows by quality tier because higher tiers demand finer defect detection on the cured finish.
doctrine: Cleanup is binary mechanical work — modifiers don't apply (a tall room doesn't make tape removal slower). Fixture protection removal only fires when the protection was installed (spray methods only). Clean tools is a flat 30 minutes regardless of room size, applied once per crew per room session. Final inspection slows at QT4/QT5 because the inspector is checking for finer defects at closer range.
